summary: Caledonia Mining Corp Plc filed a Form 6-K on September 23, 2026, disclosing receipt of a TR-1 notification from BlackRock, Inc. dated September 22, 2026. BlackRock crossed an AIM disclosure threshold on September 21, 2026, reporting total holdings of 7.01% of voting rights (1,355,473 votes), consisting of 4.94% direct shares, 0.94% via securities lending, and 1.12% via cash-settled CFDs. The prior notification showed 6.98%. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The disclosure reflects passive accumulation via financial instruments rather than an active campaign, but the increased stake necessitates monitoring for future activist or takeover interest.
